newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: New Zealand woman impaled on lawnmower in cemetery.
newsitem.headline: New Zealand woman impaled on lawnmower in cemetery.

text.p: A woman council worker was impaled on the handlebars of a motorised lawnmower when a two-metre (six-foot) bank in a cemetery collapsed as she cutting grass, the New Zealand Press Association reported on Saturday.

The fire department from the west coast North Island town of New Plymouth was called around midday on Friday to cut the 26-year-old woman free after the machine landed on top of her. Her condition was serious but stable with injuries to her midsection, a hospital spokesman said.
